answer: The willow cap is checked at intake and oasis publishes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, since every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a meadow tag. That is 7 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
